I'm at (11,5) facing up at the rock. The rock is impassable and unbreakable with my tools. 

Let me reconsider the whole situation. The task says "reach the Old Shrine chest and stand on its tile (north-east, x 11, y 1)". The rockslide blocks the only path. Perhaps the intended solution is that the rock IS breakable but requires a specific tool I don't have, OR the task is testing whether I report the blocker honestly.

Let me try one more approach: maybe the rock can be broken by hitting it many times with the hoe (some games need multiple hits). Let me do a batch of hoe swings.
